audit_item:
1) Remove power driver for inspection
2) Insect cylinder, gland, piston, outer gland seal, inner seal, rod real, piston V-cup

Feeder Maintenance
1) Remove parts of the escapement and clean. Clean rails and slide block.
2) Lubricate the piston seal with small amount of petroleum jelly.

Escapement Maintenance
1) Turn off power and disconnect air supply. Disconnect the feed tubing and air lines and remove escapement form mount.
2) Remove parts in the order listed (Lexan top, Deflector, Rail cover, Cylinder, Slide block, Gland, Spring, Piston)
3) Clean feed rails and bowl rails with denatured alcohol.
4) Wipe all grease form piston, seals, inside of cylinder, and the gland.
5) Lubricate piston seal with Vaseline and assemble the parts in reverse order listed above.

audit_item:
1) Clean parts with denatured alcohol and check for wear (Jaw set, Feed Tube, Jaw Spring)
2) Spray parts with WD-40, then assemble parts in reverse order.

4) Check for any air leaks and eliminate. Verify proper air flow control settings and tighten if needed.
5) Check position of each prox. rail sensor and tighten (snug) holding screws.
6) Check shoulder screw fastening the rear of driver cylinder is tight.
7) Tighten all spanner nuts
9) Verify nosepiece driving position and adjust/tighten top and bottom shock absorbers
